verdict.rationale: Anytype documents that data lives locally on the device, with a local-only mode that disables its backup node entirely, and a self-hosted network option with a team-maintained Docker image. Together these let users decide where their data physically resides. However, there is no documented region or residency selection for Anytype's own hosted sync and backup infrastructure. Moving to a self-hosted network also means exporting your channels and importing them into a new identity, and a community report notes there is no option to set the local storage path. Missing for 10: region/residency picker for Anytype-managed backup nodes, in-place migration between networks without a new identity, configurable local storage location, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted residency.
